summary.text: Brandon Markosek is a Democratic state representative from Pennsylvania House District 25 who has served since December 1, 2018 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Brandon Markosek assumed office in the Pennsylvania House on December 1, 2018, succeeding Joseph Markosek in District 25.
In the 2023-2024 session he was vice chair of the Game and Fisheries Committee and also served on the Government Oversight and Veterans Affairs and Emergency Preparedness committees.
